name: Keep an open record when a later case could change the claim

uses.action: Read a dated failure beside three later checks. Replace the market’s claim about every future piece with a traceable correction for the kettle, night shift or margins of the register.

name: Convert a loaf count into a load using the size of the loaf

uses.action: Weigh both full trays and both trays after one delivery. Six small loaves and three large ones each start at six weight units. Removing one loaf changes the scale by a different amount.

name: Give a controlled field trial and a rehearsal different purposes

uses.action: Change one thing at the Archive perch to repeat a landing. Accompany the moth to the theatre and give a waiting child a ribbon or a pause. Rehearse the other cue to explore what the same entrance can express.
